description: This file defines the Response class and related functions for handling and serializing responses in a Playwright-based automation context, including capturing snapshots, rendering modal states, and parsing structured response text.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Handles the collection, serialization, and processing of response data, including results, code snippets, images, and page snapshots.

classes.name: RenderedResponse
classes.description: Represents a structured, renderable response with methods to generate text and metadata, and to redact secrets.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses a CallToolResult object to extract structured response data, including results, code, page state, console messages, downloads, and attachments.
